$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-29 — Hasan Alizada — HAAL-092. Extended recurrence (FR-CAL-30, C-06, owner decision D-80), replacing calendar.recurrence.v1 whose four plain rules keep their meaning. Dates only: the wall-clock time of an occurrence is applied per date afterwards (time.local_to_utc.v1) and the viewer's days come from time.event_days.v1, so DST never shifts a series. Own implementation in Python and TypeScript (identical results both sides), checked against python-dateutil when the vectors were written.
purpose: Lists the dates on which an event occurs inside a window of at most 367 days for a subset of RFC 5545 RRULE (interval, weekdays, Nth weekday, last day of month, until, count), and tells whether a rule is supported and fits its start date.

start_date.description: First occurrence (the event's start date in its own zone); must itself be an occurrence of the rule.

rrule.description: null = one-off event. Otherwise an RFC 5545 RRULE value without the 'RRULE:' prefix: parts NAME=VALUE joined by ';', in any order, each at most once, upper case, no spaces. FREQ (required): DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY. INTERVAL: 1..99 (default 1). WEEKLY only — BYDAY: 1..7 different days of MO,TU,WE,TH,FR,SA,SU. MONTHLY only, at most one of — BYDAY: one weekday with an ordinal 1..4 or -1 (e.g. 2TU, -1FR); BYMONTHDAY: one day 1..31 or -1 (the last day). End, at most one of — UNTIL: a date YYYYMMDD (inclusive); COUNT: 1..999. Numbers without leading zeros or signs (except -1).

exceptions.description: Occurrence dates removed from the series (recurrence exceptions); dates that are no occurrence are ignored.

to.description: Last date of the window (inclusive); to − from ≤ 366 days.

dates.description: Occurrence dates inside the window, ascending, without exceptions.

errors.when: rrule is not null and not inside the subset described at input.rrule (any other part such as BYSETPOS, BYMONTH, WKST; UNTIL with a time; UNTIL and COUNT together; case and spacing count)
start_date is not an occurrence of the rule: weekly BYDAY without its weekday, monthly BYDAY / BYMONTHDAY naming another day, or UNTIL before start_date
to − from is more than 366 days

invariants: errors are checked in the order listed: the rule, its fit to the start, the window
no date before start_date and none after UNTIL is ever returned; start_date is always the first occurrence
rrule = null → [start_date] when start_date is inside the window, else []
periods: every INTERVAL days, weeks, months or years counted from the period of start_date; weeks run Monday to Sunday (RFC 5545 default WKST=MO), whatever the user's first day of the week
WEEKLY → in every INTERVAL-th week the BYDAY days (default: the weekday of start_date)

MONTHLY → in every INTERVAL-th month: BYDAY nth weekday (1..4 always exist; -1 = the last), BYMONTHDAY -1 = the last day, BYMONTHDAY n or the day of start_date otherwise — months without that day are skipped (RFC 5545), never moved to the last day
YEARLY → the day and month of start_date every INTERVAL-th year; 29 February only in leap years
COUNT counts occurrences from start_date on, excluded dates included (RFC 5545): an excluded date does not make the series longer
no date after 9999-12-31; every occurrence spans one day; the result depends on dates only — no time zone, no clock
the v1 rules FREQ=DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY give the same dates as in calendar.recurrence.v1
